faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Raigad District in Maharashtra for filling up contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) under the Raigad District administration.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies available for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) recruitment drive in Raigad District.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates need to send filled forms by post.

faq.question: Q5. When is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Raigad District recruitment is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age to be eligible for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 100/- payable as per the notification instructions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC and ST candidates is discounted to Rs. 50/- as stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, subsequent Document Verification, and the preparation of a final Merit List.

faq.question: Q10. When is the written exam scheduled?
faq.answer: The written examination for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) position is scheduled to be conducted on 15 November 2026.
